limitations: Static raw comparison only; generated/build/security interpretation is unavailable without Malhar analysis.
Source override is user supplied; full commit URL is a comparison target, not proof of release correspondence.
No submodule or LFS materialization, target scripts, rebuild, provenance or model execution.
M0 adapter only establishes the shared EvidenceBundle to AnalysisResults boundary; deterministic analysis rules are not implemented yet.
No evidence is retrieved or chunked in M0. Evidence IDs and locations remain owned by the supplied bundle.
No package acquisition, provenance verification, cryptographic trust decision, or product model inference is performed by this component.

coordination: Explicit reviewed team source, isolated from the product workspace; no resolver invoked, no external message sent.
